name: upkeep
description: One window for the apps the package manager misses.

scripts.dev: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun dev
scripts.build: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.validate: bun run prepare:eb && bun run fmt:check && bun run i18n:check && bun run --parallel lint check test:coverage deadcode && bun run build:view && bun run e2e
scripts.validate:quick: bun run prepare:eb && bun run fmt:check && bun run i18n:check && bun run --parallel lint check test:coverage deadcode && bun run build:view && node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --only-changed=main --project=chromium --pass-with-no-tests
